question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Annivarsary**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word.
 
• **Anniversary: **the date on which an event took place or an institution was founded in a previous year.
 
 
• **Example**: *My wife gave me a new watch on the **anniversary**__.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

**Let's look at the meaning of other words-**

__
 
• Anonymous- (of a person) with a name that is not known or that is not made public
 
• Announcement- something that someone says officially, giving information about something
 
• Anguish- extreme unhappiness caused by physical or mental suffering

• **Anonymous: **(किसी व्यक्ति का) एक ऐसे नाम के साथ जो ज्ञात नहीं है या जिसे सार्वजनिक नहीं किया गया है
 
• **Announcement: **कुछ ऐसा जो कोई आधिकारिक तौर पर कहता है, किसी चीज की जानकारी देता है
